zh: 这事我来处理。
en: I'll handle this.
alt: Leave it with me.
I'll take care of it.
point: 话题‘这事’放句首，英文要放到动词后：I'll handle this

zh: 那个报告你看了吗？
en: Have you read that report?
alt: Did you get a chance to look at that report?
point: 宾语放回动词后：Have you read that report?

zh: 把电脑重启一下。
en: Try restarting your computer.
alt: Give your computer a restart.
Restart your computer.
point: 把字句：动词在前，宾语在后：restart your computer

zh: 密码我已经改了。
en: I've already changed the password.
alt: I've updated the password already.
point: ‘密码’ 是宾语，要放到 changed 后面

zh: 把菜单给我看一下。
en: Could I see the menu, please?
alt: Can I have a look at the menu?
point: ‘把…给我看’ 不直译 give me look，说 Could I see …

zh: 这道菜我没点。
en: I didn't order this.
alt: This isn't what I ordered.
point: ‘这道菜’ 是宾语，英文放在 order 后面

zh: 把球传给我！
en: Pass me the ball!
alt: Pass it to me!
Pass the ball to me!
point: 把字句：Pass me the ball，不说 Take ball pass me

zh: 全黑队的比赛我每场都看。
en: I watch every All Blacks game.
alt: I never miss an All Blacks match.
point: 话题前置，英文要说 I watch every … game

zh: 这件外套我要了。
en: I'll take this jacket.
alt: I'll get this jacket.
point: 话题‘这件外套’放回 take 后面，用 I'll take

zh: 收据我放袋子里了。
en: I've put the receipt in the bag.
alt: The receipt's in the bag.
point: ‘收据’ 是宾语，英文放到 put 后面

zh: 护照你带了吗？
en: Have you got your passport?
alt: Did you bring your passport?
point: 话题‘护照’放回动词后：Have you got …

zh: 把行李放上面吧。
en: Put your bag up there.
alt: Pop your bag up there.
point: 把字句：put + 宾语 + 地点

zh: 这药饭后吃。
en: Take this medicine after meals.
alt: Have these tablets after food.
point: ‘这药’ 是宾语；吃药用 take，不用 eat

zh: 把袖子卷起来。
en: Roll up your sleeve, please.
alt: Can you roll your sleeve up?
point: 把字句：roll up your sleeve，宾语在动词后

zh: 把门关上。
en: Close the door.
alt: Shut the door, please.
point: 把字句不译‘把’，动词直接带宾语：close the door

zh: 垃圾你倒了吗？
en: Have you taken the rubbish out?
alt: Did you put the bins out?
point: ‘倒垃圾’ 是 take the rubbish out，不是 pour

zh: 这个周末的烧烤你来吗？
en: Are you coming to the barbie this weekend?
alt: Are you coming to the barbecue this weekend?
point: 话题‘烧烤’放到 coming to 后面

zh: 你的号码我存了。
en: I've saved your number.
alt: I've got your number now.
point: ‘你的号码’ 是宾语，放到 saved 后面

zh: 钱我已经转了。
en: I've already transferred the money.
alt: I've sent the money already.
The money's been transferred.
point: ‘钱’ 放句首是话题，英文放回 transferred 后面

zh: 这张卡我不用了。
en: I don't use this card any more.
alt: I've stopped using this card.
point: 话题‘这张卡’放回 use 后面；‘不…了’ 用 any more

zh: 这个客户的邮件你帮我回一下，我今天下午不在。
en: Could you reply to this client's email for me? I'm out this afternoon.
alt: Can you get back to this client for me? I'm not around this afternoon.
point: 话题‘客户的邮件’放回 reply to 后面，别漏 to

zh: 会议纪要我已经发到 Teams 上了，你看一下。
en: I've posted the meeting notes on Teams, have a look.
alt: The minutes are up on Teams — can you take a look?
point: ‘会议纪要’ 是宾语，放到 posted 后面

zh: 把这个 bug 修好再上线。
en: Let's fix this bug before we push it live.
alt: We need to sort out this bug before it goes live.
point: 把字句：fix this bug；‘再上线’ 用 before

zh: 那个服务器的密码你知道吗？我找不到了。
en: Do you know the password for that server? I can't find it.
alt: Have you got the login for that server? I've lost it.
point: 话题放回 know 后面，第二句别漏 it

zh: 把辣椒放旁边，我朋友不吃辣。
en: Could you put the chilli on the side? My friend can't handle spicy food.
alt: Can we have the chilli on the side, please? My mate doesn't eat spicy stuff.
point: 把字句：put + 宾语 + on the side；chilli 英式拼写

zh: 这家的鱼和薯条我吃过好几次了。
en: I've had the fish and chips here a few times.
alt: I've eaten their fish and chips quite a few times.
point: 话题‘鱼和薯条’放回 had 后面，吃用 have

zh: 这双跑鞋我穿了两年了，该换了。
en: I've had these running shoes for two years, so it's time for a new pair.
alt: I've been wearing these running shoes for two years — they need replacing.
point: 话题‘跑鞋’放回 had 后面；‘该换了’ 补 it's time

zh: 把门票提前买好，决赛肯定卖光。
en: Get the tickets early, the final's going to sell out for sure.
alt: Buy your tickets in advance — the final will definitely sell out.
point: 把字句：get the tickets early；第二句补主语

zh: 这个牌子的咖啡我在 Countdown 买不到。
en: I can't find this brand of coffee at Countdown.
alt: Countdown doesn't stock this brand of coffee.
point: 话题‘这个牌子的咖啡’放回 find 后面

zh: 把这个换成大一号的可以吗？
en: Could I swap this for a size up?
alt: Can I exchange this for the next size up?
point: ‘把 A 换成 B’ = swap / exchange A for B

zh: 酒店我订好了，机票你来订。
en: I've booked the hotel, so can you sort out the flights?
alt: I've done the hotel booking — can you book the flights?
point: 两个话题都放回动词后：booked the hotel / sort out the flights

zh: 把车停在机场的长期停车场，比较便宜。
en: Leave the car in the long-term car park at the airport, it's cheaper.
alt: Park in the airport's long-stay car park — it works out cheaper.
point: 把字句：leave the car + 地点；停车场 = car park

zh: 这个流感疫苗我去年已经打过了。
en: I already had the flu jab last year.
alt: I got my flu vaccine last year already.
point: 话题‘疫苗’放回动词后；打疫苗用 have / get

zh: 把这些单子交给前台，然后在外面等着叫号。
en: Hand these forms in at reception, then wait outside until they call your name.
alt: Give these forms to the front desk and wait outside to be called.
point: 把字句：hand + 宾语 + in；叫号 = call your name

zh: 洗碗机里的碗你拿出来了吗？我要放脏的进去。
en: Have you emptied the dishwasher? I want to load the dirty dishes.
alt: Did you unload the dishwasher? I need to put the dirty stuff in.
point: ‘碗拿出来’ 英文说 empty the dishwasher

zh: 把热泵调到二十度，晚上会冷。
en: Set the heat pump to twenty, it'll be cold tonight.
alt: Can you put the heat pump on 20? It's going to get cold tonight.
point: 把字句：set + 宾语 + to；NZ 空调叫 heat pump

zh: 你介绍的那家咖啡馆我去了，flat white 真不错。
en: I tried that café you recommended, the flat white was really good.
alt: I went to the café you told me about — great flat white.
point: 话题‘那家咖啡馆’放回 tried 后面

zh: 把照片发群里吧，大家都想要。
en: Send the photos to the group chat, everyone wants a copy.
alt: Can you share the photos in the group? Everyone's keen to see them.
point: 把字句：send the photos to …

zh: 这顿饭你先付，钱回头我们再算。
en: Can you pay for this one, and we'll settle up later?
alt: You get this, and we'll sort out the money afterwards.
point: 话题‘钱’ 用 settle up，不说 calculate the money

zh: 把这张发票报销一下，下个月工资里一起发。
en: Put this receipt through as an expense claim, it'll be paid with next month's salary.
alt: Claim this receipt as an expense and you'll get it back in next month's pay.
point: ‘把…报销’ = put … through as an expense claim

zh: 客户那边的需求我先跟进着，有什么变化我第一时间告诉大家。
en: I'll keep following up on the client's requirements and let everyone know straight away if anything changes.
alt: I'll stay on top of what the client needs and keep you all in the loop if anything shifts.
point: 话题‘客户的需求’放回 follow up on 后面；第一时间 = straight away

zh: 预算的事我已经跟财务说过了，他们说这个季度批不下来。
en: I've already raised the budget with finance, and they said it won't be approved this quarter.
alt: I've had a word with finance about the budget — they reckon it won't get signed off this quarter.
point: ‘预算的事’ 用 raise … with；‘批不下来’ 用被动

zh: 把旧的数据库先备份一下，迁移的时候万一出问题还能回滚。
en: Back up the old database first, so we can roll back if anything goes wrong during the migration.
alt: Let's take a backup of the old database before migrating, just in case we need to roll back.
point: 把字句：back up + 宾语；‘万一’ 用 if anything goes wrong

zh: 这个需求你先别管了，下个版本再做，先把那几个 bug 修了。
en: Don't worry about this feature for now, we'll do it in the next release. Let's get those bugs fixed first.
alt: Park this feature till the next release and focus on fixing those bugs first.
point: 话题‘这个需求’放回动词后；把字句用 get … fixed

zh: 圣诞节的聚餐我订了 Ponsonby 那家意大利餐厅，十二个人，七点半。
en: I've booked that Italian place in Ponsonby for the Christmas do, a table for twelve at half seven.
alt: For the Christmas dinner, I've reserved a table for 12 at 7:30 at the Italian restaurant in Ponsonby.
point: 话题‘圣诞聚餐’ 用 for 引出；七点半可说 half seven

zh: 这份牛排我要的是五分熟，这个太老了，能帮我换一份吗？
en: I ordered this steak medium, but it's come out pretty well done. Would you mind changing it?
alt: I asked for the steak medium and this one's overcooked — could I get another one, please?
point: 话题‘牛排’放回 ordered 后面；五分熟 = medium

zh: 下周比赛的名单我已经发给教练了，你要是来不了提前说一声。
en: I've sent the team list for next week's game to the coach, so give me a heads-up if you can't play.
alt: The coach has got the team sheet for next week — let me know early if you're not available.
point: 话题‘名单’放回 sent 后面；提前说一声 = give me a heads-up

zh: 健身房的会员我取消了，太贵了，现在每天早上去海边跑步。
en: I've cancelled my gym membership because it was way too expensive, so now I run along the beach every morning.
alt: I gave up the gym because it cost too much, and I go for a run on the beach every morning instead.
point: 话题‘健身房会员’放回 cancelled 后面

zh: 这台电视我上周在 Noel Leeming 买的，现在降了两百块，能退差价吗？
en: I bought this TV at Noel Leeming last week and it's now two hundred dollars cheaper. Can I get the difference refunded?
alt: I got this TV last week and it's dropped by $200 since — could you refund the difference?
point: 话题‘这台电视’放回 bought 后面；退差价 = refund the difference

zh: 把这些放购物车里先别结账，我再看看有没有优惠码。
en: Leave these in the cart for now and don't check out yet — I want to see if there's a discount code.
alt: Keep these in the basket but hold off on paying until I've looked for a promo code.
point: 把字句：leave these in the cart；结账 = check out

zh: 去皇后镇的行程我大概排好了，住的地方你帮忙看看，最好离市中心近一点。
en: I've roughly planned out the Queenstown trip. Could you look into where we'll stay? Ideally somewhere close to town.
alt: I've pretty much sorted the itinerary for Queenstown — can you find us accommodation, preferably near the town centre?
point: 两个话题都放回动词后：planned out the trip / look into …

zh: 把签证材料复印两份，原件随身带着，别托运。
en: Make two copies of your visa documents and keep the originals in your carry-on, don't check them in.
alt: Photocopy the visa paperwork twice and keep the originals with you rather than in your checked bag.
point: 把字句：make copies of …；托运 = check in

zh: 医生开的药我吃了一个星期了，咳嗽还是没好，要不要再去看看？
en: I've been taking the medication the doctor gave me for a week, but my cough still hasn't cleared up. Should I go back?
alt: I've had a week of the meds the GP prescribed and the cough's still hanging around — do you think I should see her again?
point: 话题‘医生开的药’放回 taking 后面；‘没好’ 用 clear up

zh: 体检结果我拿到了，胆固醇有点高，医生让我少吃油炸的东西。
en: I've got my check-up results back. My cholesterol's a bit high, so the doctor wants me to cut down on fried food.
alt: My blood test results came back with slightly high cholesterol, so I've been told to cut back on fried stuff.
point: 话题‘体检结果’放回 got … back；少吃 = cut down on

zh: 客厅的灯泡坏了好几天了，新的我买了，你帮我换一下吧，我够不着。
en: The light bulb in the lounge has been out for days. I've bought a new one — could you change it? I can't reach.
alt: I picked up a new bulb for the lounge since the old one's been dead for days — can you swap it over? I can't reach.
point: 话题‘新的’放回 bought 后面；change it 别漏 it

zh: 把洗衣机里的衣服晾出去，今天太阳好，晚上之前应该能干。
en: Hang the washing out — it's sunny today, so it should be dry by tonight.
alt: Can you put the washing on the line? It's a nice day, so it'll dry before evening.
point: 把字句：hang the washing out；晾衣服不用 dry clothes

zh: 你推荐的那部剧我一口气看完了，结局有点意外，下次见面好好聊聊。
en: I binge-watched that show you recommended, and the ending was a bit of a surprise. Let's have a proper chat about it next time.
alt: I got through that series you suggested in one go and didn't see the ending coming! We'll have to talk about it when we catch up.
point: 话题‘那部剧’放回动词后；一口气看完 = binge-watch

zh: 下个月的乔迁派对我来张罗，邀请朋友你负责，吃的大家各带一样。
en: I'll organise the housewarming next month. Can you sort out the invites? Everyone can bring a plate.
alt: Leave the housewarming to me — you handle inviting people, and we'll make it a bring-a-plate thing.
point: 话题‘乔迁派对’放回 organise 后；各带一样 = bring a plate

zh: 这个月的电费我已经交了，网费你来付，下个月再轮换。
en: I've paid the power bill this month, so can you cover the internet? We'll swap round next month.
alt: The electricity's been paid for this month — you get the broadband and we'll switch next month.
point: 话题‘电费 / 网费’放回 paid / cover 后面；电费 = power bill

zh: 房贷的事我问过银行了，固定两年的利率比较划算，你觉得呢？
en: I've talked to the bank about the mortgage, and a two-year fixed rate seems like the best deal. What do you think?
alt: I checked with the bank about the mortgage — fixing for two years looks like the best option. Thoughts?
point: 话题‘房贷的事’ 用 talk to … about；划算 = the best deal

zh: 这个会我就不参加了。
en: I'll skip this meeting.
alt: I'm going to give this meeting a miss.
point: 话题‘这个会’放回 skip 后面；不参加 = skip

zh: 走之前把屏幕锁上。
en: Lock your screen before you go.
alt: Lock your computer before you leave.
point: 把字句：lock your screen，宾语跟在动词后

zh: 这顿我来付。
en: I'll get this one.
alt: This one's on me.
I'll pay for this.
point: ‘这顿’ 是话题，英文说 I'll get this one

zh: 这项运动我从来没玩过。
en: I've never played this sport.
alt: I've never tried this sport before.
point: 话题‘这项运动’放回 played 后面

zh: 购物袋我自己带了。
en: I've brought my own bag.
alt: I've got my own bag, thanks.
point: 话题‘购物袋’放回 brought 后；自己带 = my own

zh: 登机牌我已经打印好了。
en: I've already printed our boarding passes.
alt: Our boarding passes are printed already.
point: ‘登机牌’ 是宾语，放到 printed 后面

zh: 这种药我过敏。
en: I'm allergic to this medicine.
alt: This medication gives me an allergic reaction.
point: 话题‘这种药’放到 allergic to 后面

zh: 你把地拖一下吧。
en: Can you mop the floor?
alt: Could you give the floor a mop?
point: 把字句：mop the floor，拖地不是 drag

zh: 那个笑话我听过了。
en: I've heard that joke before.
alt: I've already heard that one.
point: 话题‘那个笑话’放回 heard 后面

zh: 这笔钱我先借你。
en: I'll lend you the money for now.
alt: I can lend you the money for the time being.
point: ‘借你’ 是 lend you，不是 borrow you

zh: 简历我已经发过去了。
en: I've already sent my CV.
alt: I've sent off my CV already.
point: 话题‘简历’放回 sent 后；简历 = CV

zh: 这份工作我想试试。
en: I want to go for this job.
alt: I'd like to apply for this job.
point: 话题放回动词后；‘试试’ 工作说 go for

zh: 这个合同我还没签。
en: I haven't signed this contract yet.
alt: I'm yet to sign this contract.
point: ‘这个合同’ 放回 signed 后；还没 = haven't … yet

zh: 这本书我借走了。
en: I've taken this book out.
alt: I've checked this book out.
I've borrowed this book.
point: 图书馆借书说 take out，宾语在中间

zh: 作业你交了吗？
en: Have you handed in your assignment?
alt: Did you hand your assignment in?
point: 话题‘作业’放回动词后；交作业 = hand in

zh: 上课把手机调成静音。
en: Put your phone on silent in class.
alt: Switch your phone to silent during class.
point: ‘把…调成静音’ = put … on silent

zh: 这个月的房租我交了。
en: I've paid this month's rent.
alt: This month's rent is paid.
point: 话题‘房租’放回 paid 后面；交房租用 pay

zh: 这套房子我们已经看过了。
en: We've already viewed this flat.
alt: We've seen this place already.
point: 话题放回动词后；看房 = view a flat

zh: 钥匙我放信箱里了。
en: I've left the keys in the letterbox.
alt: I put the keys in the letterbox.
point: ‘钥匙’ 是宾语；放下就走用 leave

zh: 你家的猫我今天早上看到了。
en: I saw your cat this morning.
alt: I spotted your cat this morning.
point: 话题‘你家的猫’放回 saw 后面

zh: 能把音乐关小一点吗？
en: Could you turn the music down?
alt: Would you mind turning the music down a bit?
point: 把…关小 = turn down，不说 close small

zh: 这棵树我来修剪。
en: I'll trim this tree.
alt: I'll cut this tree back.
point: 话题‘这棵树’放回 trim 后面

zh: 这张账单我看不懂。
en: I don't understand this bill.
alt: This bill doesn't make sense to me.
point: 话题‘这张账单’放回 understand 后面

zh: 出门前把灯都关了。
en: Turn all the lights off before you go out.
alt: Switch off all the lights before you leave.
point: 把…关了 = turn off，灯用复数 lights

zh: 这个手机套餐我不要了。
en: I want to cancel this mobile plan.
alt: I'd like to cancel this phone plan.
point: 话题放回动词后；‘不要了’ 说 cancel

zh: 水龙头我修好了。
en: I've fixed the tap.
alt: The tap's fixed now.
point: 话题‘水龙头’放回 fixed 后；水龙头 = tap

zh: 先把总阀关了。
en: Turn the water off at the mains first.
alt: Shut off the water at the mains first.
point: 把总阀关了 = turn the water off at the mains

zh: 水管工的报价我收到了。
en: I've got the plumber's quote.
alt: The plumber's quote has come through.
point: ‘报价’ 是宾语，放到 got 后面；报价 = quote

zh: 签证申请我在网上交了。
en: I submitted my visa application online.
alt: I lodged my visa application online.
point: 话题‘签证申请’放回动词后；交申请 = submit / lodge

zh: 护照照片你拍了吗？
en: Have you had your passport photo taken?
alt: Have you got your passport photo done?
point: 别人给你拍照用 have … taken

zh: 把地址写在这儿。
en: Write your address here.
alt: Put your address down here.
point: 把字句：write your address here

zh: 我的钱包丢了。
en: I've lost my wallet.
alt: My wallet's gone missing.
point: 中文‘钱包’做主语，英文用 I've lost my wallet

zh: 快把煤气关掉！
en: Turn off the gas!
alt: Switch the gas off, quick!
point: 把字句：turn off the gas，宾语在后

zh: 车牌号我记下来了。
en: I wrote down the number plate.
alt: I've got the plate number written down.
point: 话题放回动词后；车牌 = number plate

zh: 车我停在外面了。
en: I've parked outside.
alt: The car's parked outside.
point: ‘车我停’ 英文 park 本身就是停车，不必说 the car

zh: 把安全带系上。
en: Put your seatbelt on.
alt: Buckle up.
point: 把字句：put your seatbelt on，系 = put on

zh: 油我已经加满了。
en: I've already filled up the tank.
alt: I've filled the car up already.
point: 话题‘油’ 不直译 oil；加满油 = fill up

zh: 防晒霜你抹了吗？
en: Have you put sunscreen on?
alt: Have you got sunblock on?
point: 话题‘防晒霜’放回动词后；抹 = put on

zh: 帐篷就搭这儿吧。
en: Let's pitch the tent here.
alt: Let's put the tent up here.
point: 话题‘帐篷’放回动词后；搭帐篷 = pitch

zh: 这条步道我走过。
en: I've done this track before.
alt: I've walked this track before.
point: 话题放回动词后；步道 = track，走 = do

zh: 这部电影我看过了。
en: I've already seen this movie.
alt: I've seen this film already.
point: 话题‘这部电影’放回 seen 后面

zh: 这本书我看了一半。
en: I'm halfway through this book.
alt: I've read half of this book.
point: ‘看了一半’ 说 halfway through，书放在后面

zh: 这首歌我天天听。
en: I listen to this song every day.
alt: I play this song every day.
point: 话题放回 listen to 后面，别漏 to

zh: 礼物我包好了。
en: I've wrapped the present.
alt: The present's all wrapped.
point: 话题‘礼物’放回 wrapped 后；包礼物 = wrap

zh: 生日蛋糕我来订。
en: I'll order the birthday cake.
alt: Leave the birthday cake to me.
point: 话题‘蛋糕’放回 order 后面

zh: 红包我都准备好了。
en: I've got the red envelopes ready.
alt: The red envelopes are all ready.
point: 准备好 = get … ready，宾语夹在中间

zh: 孩子今天我去接。
en: I'll pick up the kids today.
alt: I'll get the kids today.
point: 话题‘孩子’放回动词后；接孩子 = pick up

zh: 把玩具收起来。
en: Put your toys away.
alt: Tidy up your toys.
point: 把…收起来 = put … away

zh: 他的午饭我装好了。
en: I've packed his lunch.
alt: His lunch is packed.
point: ‘午饭’ 放回 packed 后；装午饭 = pack lunch

zh: 狗我已经遛过了。
en: I've already walked the dog.
alt: I've taken the dog out already.
point: 话题‘狗’放回动词后；遛狗 = walk the dog

zh: 把猫放出去吧。
en: Let the cat out.
alt: Can you let the cat outside?
point: 把…放出去 = let … out

zh: 猫粮我顺路买了。
en: I picked up some cat food on the way.
alt: I grabbed cat food on my way home.
point: 话题‘猫粮’放回动词后；顺路买 = pick up

zh: 这件事我不怪你。
en: I don't blame you for this.
alt: This isn't your fault.
point: 话题‘这件事’放到 blame you for 后面

zh: 你的话我记住了。
en: I'll remember what you said.
alt: I'll keep what you said in mind.
point: ‘你的话’ 不说 your words，说 what you said

zh: 那天的事我很抱歉。
en: I'm sorry about the other day.
alt: I feel bad about what happened the other day.
point: 话题‘那天的事’ 用 sorry about 引出

zh: 这个项目的进度你跟老板汇报一下，他下午要问。
en: Can you update the boss on this project? He'll be asking about it this afternoon.
alt: Could you give the boss a progress update? He'll want to know this afternoon.
point: 话题‘进度’放后；汇报 = update sb on sth

zh: 把旧手机里的照片都传到云盘上，然后恢复出厂设置。
en: Upload all the photos from your old phone to the cloud, then do a factory reset.
alt: Back up the photos on your old phone to the cloud before you factory reset it.
point: 把字句：upload + 宾语 + to the cloud

zh: 剩下的菜帮我打包，我明天当午饭。
en: Could you box up the leftovers? I'll have them for lunch tomorrow.
alt: Can I get the rest of this to take away? It'll be my lunch tomorrow.
point: 话题‘剩下的菜’放回 box up 后；打包 = box up

zh: 周六的比赛我去不了，我脚踝扭了。
en: I can't make Saturday's game because I've twisted my ankle.
alt: I'll have to miss Saturday's match — I've rolled my ankle.
point: 话题‘比赛’放到 make 后；去不了 = can't make

zh: 这双鞋我在网上看到过更便宜的。
en: I've seen these shoes cheaper online.
alt: I've seen these shoes for less online.
point: 话题‘这双鞋’放回 seen 后，cheaper 跟在宾语后

zh: 行李箱我收拾好了，就差充电器没装。
en: I've packed my suitcase, I just need to put the charger in.
alt: My suitcase is packed apart from the charger.
point: 话题‘行李箱’放回 packed 后；‘就差’ 用 just need to

zh: 看牙的预约我改到下周三了。
en: I've moved my dentist appointment to next Wednesday.
alt: I've rescheduled my dental appointment for next Wednesday.
point: 话题‘预约’放回 moved 后；改到 = move to

zh: 把冰箱里过期的东西都扔了，太占地方了。
en: Throw out everything in the fridge that's past its date, it's taking up too much space.
alt: Chuck out all the expired stuff in the fridge — it's taking up room.
point: 把…扔了 = throw out；过期 = past its date

zh: 你朋友的名字我又忘了，不好意思，叫什么来着？
en: Sorry, I've forgotten your friend's name again. What was it?
alt: I'm so sorry, your friend's name has slipped my mind again — what was it?
point: 话题‘名字’放回 forgotten 后；叫什么来着 = What was it?

zh: 这个月的预算我做好了，外卖得少点了。
en: I've done this month's budget, and we need to cut back on takeaways.
alt: I've worked out this month's budget — we'll have to cut down on takeaways.
point: 话题‘预算’放回 done 后；少点 = cut back on

zh: 推荐信我已经找前老板要了，他说这周给我。
en: I've asked my old boss for a reference, and he said he'll send it this week.
alt: My former manager's agreed to write me a reference this week.
point: ‘推荐信找人要’ = ask sb for a reference

zh: 这份工作的薪水我觉得还可以再谈谈。
en: I think we could still negotiate the salary for this role.
alt: I reckon there's still room to negotiate the pay for this job.
point: 话题‘薪水’放回 negotiate 后面

zh: 求职信你帮我看一下，我明天就要投了。
en: Could you look over my cover letter? I'm sending it off tomorrow.
alt: Can you check my cover letter for me? I'm applying tomorrow.
point: 话题放回 look over 后；求职信 = cover letter

zh: 这门课我去年挂了，今年得重修。
en: I failed this paper last year, so I have to retake it this year.
alt: I didn't pass this course last year, so I'm redoing it.
point: 话题‘这门课’放回 failed 后；挂科 = fail

zh: 把你的笔记借我看看，我上周病了没来。
en: Can I borrow your notes? I was sick last week and missed class.
alt: Could I have a look at your notes? I was off sick last week.
point: ‘把…借我’ 换成 Can I borrow your notes

zh: 雅思成绩我昨天拿到了，口语只有六分。
en: I got my IELTS results yesterday, and I only got a six for speaking.
alt: My IELTS results came out yesterday — just a six in speaking.
point: 话题‘成绩’放回 got 后；‘口语’ 用 for speaking

zh: 押金房东到现在还没退给我们。
en: The landlord still hasn't given us our bond back.
alt: We still haven't got our bond back from the landlord.
point: 话题‘押金’放进 give us … back；押金 = bond

zh: 把你的东西从客厅搬走，明天有人来看房。
en: Move your stuff out of the lounge, someone's coming to view the flat tomorrow.
alt: Can you clear your things out of the lounge? We've got a viewing tomorrow.
point: 把字句：move + 宾语 + out of；看房 = view

zh: 坏掉的百叶窗我已经跟物业说了。
en: I've already told the property manager about the broken blind.
alt: I've reported the broken blind to the property manager.
point: 话题‘百叶窗’ 用 tell sb about sth 引出

zh: 你们家的垃圾桶我帮你们拉进来了，风太大。
en: I brought your bins in for you because it was really windy.
alt: It was blowing a gale, so I wheeled your bins in.
point: 话题‘垃圾桶’放进 bring … in 中间

zh: 社区的圣诞活动我报名当志愿者了。
en: I've signed up to volunteer at the community Christmas event.
alt: I've put my name down as a volunteer for the community Christmas do.
point: 话题‘活动’放到 volunteer at 后面

zh: 能把你的车往前挪一点吗？我出不去了。
en: Could you move your car forward a bit? I can't get out.
alt: Would you mind shifting your car up a little? I'm blocked in.
point: 把…往前挪 = move … forward；出不去 = can't get out

zh: 宽带的事我打了三次电话，还是没解决。
en: I've called about the broadband three times, and it's still not sorted.
alt: I've rung them three times about the internet and it's still not fixed.
point: 话题‘宽带的事’ 用 call about；没解决 = not sorted

zh: 把热水温度调低一点，太烫了。
en: Can you turn the hot water down a bit? It's far too hot.
alt: Could you lower the water temperature a little? It's scalding.
point: 把…调低 = turn down；宾语夹中间

zh: 这个月的电费我觉得他们算错了，比平时高一倍。
en: I think they've got this month's power bill wrong, it's double the usual.
alt: This month's power bill looks wrong to me — it's twice what we normally pay.
point: 话题‘电费’放进 get … wrong 中间

zh: 洗衣机我已经找人来修了，明天上午到。
en: I've got someone coming to fix the washing machine tomorrow morning.
alt: Someone's coming round to repair the washing machine tomorrow morning.
point: ‘找人来修’ = get someone coming to fix

zh: 把漏水的地方拍几张照片发给我。
en: Take a few photos of the leak and send them to me.
alt: Snap a couple of pictures of the leak and send them through.
point: 把…拍照片 = take photos of；send them 别漏 them

zh: 这个书架是我自己装的，有点歪。
en: I put this bookshelf together myself, and it's a bit wonky.
alt: I assembled this bookcase myself, so it's slightly crooked.
point: 话题放进 put … together；装家具 = put together

zh: 新地址我已经在网上更新了。
en: I've already updated my address online.
alt: I've changed my address online already.
point: 话题‘新地址’放回 updated 后面

zh: 出生证明的翻译件我还没拿到，下周才好。
en: I haven't got the translation of my birth certificate yet, it'll be ready next week.
alt: My birth certificate translation won't be ready until next week.
point: 话题‘翻译件’放回 got 后；‘才好’ 用 will be ready

zh: 这封信你寄挂号，别寄平信。
en: Send this letter by tracked post rather than standard mail.
alt: Make sure this letter goes tracked, not standard post.
point: 话题‘这封信’放回 send 后；寄挂号 = send by tracked post

zh: 手机我在公交上弄丢了，能帮我打一下吗？
en: I've lost my phone on the bus. Could you give it a ring?
alt: I left my phone on the bus — can you call it for me?
point: 话题‘手机’放回 lost 后；帮我打 = give it a ring

zh: 把伤口按住，救护车马上就到。
en: Keep pressure on the wound, the ambulance is on its way.
alt: Press down hard on the cut — the ambulance is coming.
point: 把伤口按住 = keep pressure on the wound

zh: 地震包我们放在门口的柜子里。
en: We keep our earthquake kit in the cupboard by the door.
alt: Our emergency kit is in the cupboard next to the front door.
point: 话题‘地震包’放回 keep 后面

zh: 车的 WOF 我下周去做。
en: I'm getting the car's WOF done next week.
alt: I'm taking the car in for its WOF next week.
point: 话题放后；做 WOF = get … done

zh: 把大灯打开，前面有雾。
en: Turn your headlights on, there's fog ahead.
alt: Put your lights on — it's foggy up ahead.
point: 把大灯打开 = turn headlights on；第二句补 there's

zh: 你的车我借一下行吗？我的在修。
en: Can I borrow your car? Mine's in the shop.
alt: Could I use your car? Mine's in for repairs.
point: 话题‘你的车’放回 borrow 后；在修 = in the shop

zh: 雨衣你带上吧，山上天气说变就变。
en: Take your raincoat, the weather up in the hills can change really fast.
alt: Bring a rain jacket — the weather in the hills turns quickly.
point: 话题‘雨衣’放回 take 后；说变就变 = change fast

zh: 把垃圾都带下山，别留在营地。
en: Take all your rubbish back down with you, don't leave it at the campsite.
alt: Pack out all your rubbish rather than leaving it at the campsite.
point: 把…带下山 = take … back down with you

zh: 这片海滩我小时候常来。
en: I used to come to this beach all the time as a kid.
alt: I came to this beach a lot when I was little.
point: 话题‘海滩’放到 come to 后；常来 = used to

zh: 这个乐队的演唱会我看过两次。
en: I've seen this band live twice.
alt: I've been to two of this band's gigs.
point: ‘演唱会我看过’ 英文说 see the band live

zh: 你那个新游戏借我玩几天吧。
en: Can I borrow that new game of yours for a few days?
alt: Would you lend me your new game for a few days?
point: 话题放回 borrow 后；你那个 = that … of yours

zh: 那本小说我借给 Amy 了，她还没还。
en: I lent that novel to Amy and she still hasn't given it back.
alt: Amy's still got that novel I lent her.
point: 话题‘小说’放回 lent 后；还 = give back

zh: 今年的年夜饭我们在外面吃。
en: We're eating out for Chinese New Year's Eve this year.
alt: This year we're having our New Year's Eve dinner at a restaurant.
point: 话题‘年夜饭’ 用 for 引出；在外面吃 = eat out

zh: 婚礼的回执我忘了寄，现在还来得及吗？
en: I forgot to send back the wedding RSVP. Is it too late now?
alt: I never RSVPed to the wedding — is it too late?
point: 话题放回 send back 后；回执 = RSVP

zh: 把气球挂在门口，客人好找。
en: Hang the balloons by the front door so the guests can find us.
alt: Tie the balloons to the gate so people can spot the house.
point: 把…挂在门口 = hang … by the door；‘好找’ 用 so

zh: 家长会你去吧，我那天要上班。
en: Can you go to the parent-teacher interview? I'm working that day.
alt: Could you do the parent-teacher meeting? I've got work that day.
point: 话题‘家长会’放回 go to 后面

zh: 把他的鞋带系好，别让他摔了。
en: Tie his shoelaces properly so he doesn't trip over.
alt: Do his laces up so he doesn't fall over.
point: 把鞋带系好 = tie shoelaces；‘别让他’ 用 so … doesn't

zh: 我妈的生日礼物我还没想好。
en: I still haven't decided what to get Mum for her birthday.
alt: I haven't worked out a birthday present for Mum yet.
point: 话题‘礼物’ 变成 what to get Mum

zh: 狗的疫苗我上个月带它去打了。
en: I took the dog to get his vaccinations last month.
alt: The dog had his jabs last month.
point: 话题‘疫苗’放后；带…去打 = take … to get

zh: 把狗拴好，公园里有小孩。
en: Keep your dog on a lead, there are kids in the park.
alt: Put your dog on a lead — there are children around.
point: 把狗拴好 = keep … on a lead

zh: 我出差的时候，猫你帮我喂一下。
en: Could you feed my cat while I'm away for work?
alt: Can you look after my cat while I'm on my work trip?
point: 话题‘猫’放回 feed 后面

zh: 这件事我想了一晚上，还是觉得你说得对。
en: I thought about it all night, and I still think you're right.
alt: I slept on it, and I still reckon you're right.
point: 话题‘这件事’ 用 think about it 引出

zh: 你的心情我能理解，换我也会生气。
en: I understand how you feel. I'd be angry too in your shoes.
alt: I get how you feel — I'd be upset too if I were you.
point: ‘你的心情’ 不说 your mood，说 how you feel

zh: 有什么话就说出来，别憋在心里。
en: Just say what's on your mind, don't keep it bottled up.
alt: Get it off your chest instead of bottling it up.
point: ‘话’ 放到 say 后：what's on your mind

zh: 把我加到那个邮件组里吧，我老是收不到通知。
en: Can you add me to that mailing list? I keep missing the notifications.
alt: Could you put me on that email list? I never get the updates.
point: 把…加到 = add … to；‘老是’ 用 keep + -ing

zh: 我把会议时间搞错了，以为是三点开始。
en: I got the meeting time wrong, I thought it started at three.
alt: I mixed up the meeting time — I thought it was at three.
point: 把…搞错 = get … wrong，宾语夹中间

zh: 周报的事你别担心，我周五前交给你。
en: Don't worry about the weekly report, I'll get it to you before Friday.
alt: Leave the weekly report with me — you'll have it by Friday.
point: 话题‘周报的事’ 用 worry about；交给你 = get it to you

zh: 我不小心把那个文件夹删了，回收站里也找不到。
en: I accidentally deleted that folder, and it's not in the recycle bin either.
alt: I deleted that folder by mistake and I can't find it in the bin.
point: 把…删了 = delete；‘也找不到’ 用 not … either

zh: 把这个表格导出成 PDF，再发给客户。
en: Export this spreadsheet as a PDF, then send it over to the client.
alt: Save the spreadsheet as a PDF and email it to the client.
point: 把 A 导出成 B = export A as B

zh: 那个软件的许可证我们去年续过了，怎么又过期了？
en: We renewed that software licence last year, so why has it expired again?
alt: Didn't we renew the licence for that software last year? How has it run out already?
point: 话题放回 renewed 后；名词 licence 英式拼写

zh: 面试的问题我都准备好了，就怕他们问期望薪资。
en: I've prepared for all the interview questions, but I'm worried they'll ask about salary expectations.
alt: I'm ready for the interview questions — I'm just nervous about being asked what pay I want.
point: 准备问题 = prepare for the questions，别漏 for

zh: 那家公司的 offer 我拒了，通勤太远。
en: I turned down that company's offer because the commute was too long.
alt: I said no to their job offer — the commute would've been too much.
point: 话题‘offer’ 放回动词后；拒绝 = turn down

zh: 我把 LinkedIn 上的资料更新了，已经有好几个猎头联系我了。
en: I've updated my LinkedIn profile, and a few recruiters have already got in touch.
alt: Since I refreshed my LinkedIn profile, several recruiters have reached out.
point: 把资料更新 = update my profile；联系我 = get in touch

zh: 我把论文的截止日期记成下周了，结果是明天！
en: I thought the essay was due next week, but it's actually tomorrow!
alt: I had the essay deadline down as next week, but it's tomorrow!
point: ‘把 A 记成 B’ 不直译，说 I thought … was due

zh: 学费我分三期付，这样压力小一点。
en: I'm paying my fees in three instalments, so it's less of a stretch.
alt: I've split my tuition fees into three payments to make it easier.
point: 话题‘学费’放回 pay 后；分期 = in instalments

zh: 这门课的阅读材料我一篇都没看，考试肯定完了。
en: I haven't done any of the reading for this course, so I'm toast in the exam.
alt: I haven't read a single one of the course readings — the exam's going to be a disaster.
point: ‘一篇都没看’ = haven't done any of the reading

zh: 我把白衬衫和红袜子一起洗了，现在全变粉了。
en: I washed my white shirt with a red sock, and now it's all pink.
alt: A red sock got in with my white shirt and turned it pink.
point: 把 A 和 B 一起洗 = wash A with B

zh: 菜我来切，炒你来负责。
en: I'll do the chopping, and you can do the cooking.
alt: I'll chop the veggies if you do the stir-fry.
point: 话题‘菜’ 不说 cut the vegetables 也行，自然说法是 do the chopping

zh: 把可回收的东西单独放，别跟一般垃圾混在一起。
en: Put the recycling in its own bin, and don't mix it with the general rubbish.
alt: Keep the recycling separate from the normal rubbish.
point: 把字句：put … in its own bin；混在一起 = mix with

zh: 入住检查的时候我们拍了照，搬走时就不怕扣押金了。
en: We took photos at the move-in inspection, so they can't take anything off our bond later.
alt: We photographed everything when we moved in, so our bond should be safe when we leave.
point: 扣押金 = take money off the bond，不说 deduct deposit

zh: 这个房子我们挺喜欢的，就是离公交站太远了。
en: We really like this place, it's just too far from the bus stop.
alt: We love the house — the only problem is it's a long way from the bus.
point: 话题‘这个房子’放回 like 后；‘就是’ = it's just

zh: 我把房间转租给了一个朋友，房东已经同意了。
en: I've sublet my room to a friend, and the landlord's OK with it.
alt: My landlord agreed to let me sublet my room to a mate.
point: 把…转租给 = sublet … to

zh: 掉到我们院子里的苹果你随便拿，反正我们吃不完。
en: Help yourself to any apples that fall into our yard, we can't eat them all anyway.
alt: Feel free to grab the apples that drop over our side — there are too many for us.
point: 话题‘苹果’放到 help yourself to 后面

zh: 你的包裹我先帮你收了，下班过来拿吧。
en: I took your parcel in for you, so just pop over and grab it after work.
alt: I've got your parcel here — come and get it when you're home from work.
point: 话题‘包裹’放进 take … in；收包裹 = take in

zh: 这道篱笆的费用我们两家一人一半吧，怎么样？
en: How about we split the cost of the fence fifty-fifty?
alt: Shall we go halves on the new fence?
point: 话题‘费用’放回 split 后；一人一半 = fifty-fifty

zh: 我把电力公司换了一家，每个月能省不少。
en: I've switched to a different power company, and we're saving quite a bit each month.
alt: Changing power companies has saved us a fair bit every month.
point: ‘把公司换了’ 用 switch to a different …

zh: 停电的事我问过了，说要到晚上才能来电。
en: I've asked about the power cut, and they said it won't be back on till tonight.
alt: I checked on the outage — they reckon the power won't be back until this evening.
point: 话题‘停电的事’ 用 ask about；来电 = be back on

zh: 把路由器挪到客厅中间，信号会好一点。
en: Move the router to the middle of the lounge and you'll get a better signal.
alt: If you put the router in the middle of the lounge, the Wi-Fi will be stronger.
point: 把…挪到 = move … to；‘会好一点’ 用 and you'll

zh: 这台洗碗机修一次的钱都够买台新的了。
en: Getting this dishwasher fixed would cost as much as buying a new one.
alt: It'd cost about the same to repair this dishwasher as to replace it.
point: 话题‘修一次’ 变成 Getting … fixed 作主语

zh: 电工的电话我存了，下次插座坏了直接找他。
en: I've saved the electrician's number, so next time a socket stops working we can just call him.
alt: I've kept the sparky's number in case another socket packs up.
point: 话题放回 saved 后；坏了 = stops working

zh: 墙上的洞我补好了，再刷层漆就看不出来了。
en: I've patched up the hole in the wall, and once it's painted you won't be able to tell.
alt: The hole in the wall's filled now — after a coat of paint nobody will notice.
point: 话题‘墙上的洞’放回 patch up 后；看不出来 = can't tell

zh: 这件衬衫我才穿了一次就掉色了，能退吗？
en: I've only worn this shirt once and the colour's already faded. Can I return it?
alt: This shirt faded after one wear — could I bring it back?
point: 话题放回 worn 后；掉色 = fade，colour 英式拼写

zh: 网上订的沙发他们把颜色发错了。
en: They sent the wrong colour for the sofa I ordered online.
alt: The sofa I bought online arrived in the wrong colour.
point: ‘把颜色发错’ = send the wrong colour，不说 send the colour wrong

zh: 把会员卡给收银员扫一下，能打九折。
en: Get the cashier to scan your loyalty card and you'll get ten percent off.
alt: If you show your member card at the checkout, you get 10% off.
point: 把…给人扫 = get sb to scan；九折 = ten percent off

zh: 这家店的拉面我排了四十分钟队才吃上。
en: I queued for forty minutes to get the ramen at this place.
alt: I had to wait in line for forty minutes for the ramen here.
point: 话题‘拉面’放到 to get 后；排队 = queue

zh: 这个汤能不能把香菜去掉？我吃不了。
en: Could you leave the coriander out of this soup? I can't stand it.
alt: Can I have the soup without coriander, please? I don't eat it.
point: 把…去掉 = leave … out of；香菜 = coriander

zh: 位子我是用我老公的名字订的，姓陈。
en: I made the booking under my husband's name, it's Chen.
alt: The table's booked under my husband's name — Chen.
point: 话题‘位子’ 用 booking under sb's name

zh: 这笔奖金我打算存进 KiwiSaver 里。
en: I'm planning to put this bonus straight into my KiwiSaver.
alt: I'm going to stick this bonus in my KiwiSaver.
point: 话题‘奖金’放回 put 后；存进 = put into

zh: 上个月的信用卡我忘了还，被收了滞纳金。
en: I forgot to pay off last month's credit card bill and got charged a late fee.
alt: I missed last month's credit card payment and got hit with a late fee.
point: 话题‘信用卡’放回 pay off 后；还卡 = pay off

zh: 我把那条可疑的短信截了图，发给了银行。
en: I took a screenshot of that dodgy text and sent it to the bank.
alt: I screenshotted the suspicious message and forwarded it to my bank.
point: 把…截图 = take a screenshot of

zh: 护照我上周寄去续签了，到现在还没寄回来。
en: I sent my passport off for renewal last week, and it hasn't come back yet.
alt: My passport's been away for renewal since last week and I'm still waiting.
point: 把…寄去 = send … off for

zh: 这张罚单我觉得开错了，那天我根本不在那儿。
en: I think this fine was issued by mistake, because I wasn't even there that day.
alt: I don't think this ticket's right — I wasn't anywhere near there that day.
point: 话题‘罚单’ 转成被动 was issued

zh: IRD 号码我写在表格右上角了。
en: I've written my IRD number in the top right corner of the form.
alt: My IRD number's at the top right of the form.
point: 话题放回 written 后；右上角 = top right corner

zh: 我把处方拿到药房，他们说要等二十分钟。
en: I took the prescription to the pharmacy, and they said it'd be a twenty-minute wait.
alt: The chemist said my prescription would take about twenty minutes.
point: 把…拿到 = take … to；‘要等’ 用 a … wait

zh: 这颗智齿我早就想拔了，一直拖着。
en: I've been meaning to have this wisdom tooth out for ages, but I keep putting it off.
alt: I've wanted to get this wisdom tooth pulled for ages but keep delaying it.
point: 拔牙 = have a tooth out；拖着 = put off

zh: ACC 的表格医生帮我填好了，我签个字就行。
en: The GP filled in the ACC form for me, so I just need to sign it.
alt: My doctor did the ACC form — all I have to do is sign.
point: 话题‘表格’放回 filled in 后；‘帮我’ = for me

zh: 我把钥匙锁在车里了，手机也在里面。
en: I've locked my keys in the car, and my phone's in there too.
alt: My keys are locked inside the car along with my phone.
point: 把…锁在里面 = lock … in

zh: 小偷把我的车锁剪断了，把自行车骑走了。
en: A thief cut through my bike lock and rode off with the bike.
alt: Someone cut my lock and took off on my bike.
point: 把锁剪断 = cut through the lock；骑走 = ride off with

zh: 这起事故我全程都看到了，可以给警察作证。
en: I saw the whole accident, so I can give a statement to the police.
alt: I witnessed the entire crash and I'm happy to make a statement.
point: 话题‘事故’放回 saw 后；作证 = give a statement

zh: 我把车送去修了，刹车一直有怪声。
en: I've taken the car in to get the brakes looked at, they've been making a weird noise.
alt: The car's in the garage because the brakes were making a funny sound.
point: 送去修 = take in to get … looked at

zh: 停车费我用 app 付了，可以停到四点。
en: I've paid for parking on the app, so we're fine until four.
alt: Parking's paid on the app — we're good till four o'clock.
point: 话题‘停车费’ 说 pay for parking，不说 pay the parking fee

zh: 这条路我开了十年了，闭着眼都能开。
en: I've driven this road for ten years, I could do it with my eyes closed.
alt: I've been driving this road for a decade — I know it like the back of my hand.
point: 话题‘这条路’放回 driven 后

zh: 我把行程单打印出来了，海关可能要看。
en: I've printed out the itinerary in case customs want to see it.
alt: I printed our itinerary just in case customs ask for it.
point: 打印出来 = print out；‘可能要看’ 用 in case

zh: 回程的航班我改到了周日，周六的太贵了。
en: I've changed our return flight to Sunday because Saturday was too expensive.
alt: We're flying back on Sunday now — the Saturday flights cost too much.
point: 话题‘航班’放回 changed 后；改到 = change to

zh: 这家酒店我们去年住过，房间不大但很干净。
en: We stayed at this hotel last year, the rooms are small but really clean.
alt: We've been to this hotel before — tiny rooms, but spotless.
point: 话题‘酒店’ 用 stay at，别漏 at

zh: 过河的时候我踩空了，把鞋全弄湿了。
en: I slipped crossing the river and got my boots soaked.
alt: My boots got drenched when I slipped in the river.
point: 把鞋弄湿 = get my boots soaked

zh: 这条线路你们一天走不完，最好在小屋住一晚。
en: You won't finish this track in one day, so it's best to stay a night in the hut.
alt: This track's too long for a day — you'd be better off staying in the hut.
point: 话题‘线路’放回 finish 后；小屋 = hut

zh: 院子里的草我周末再割，今天太湿了。
en: I'll mow the lawn at the weekend, it's too wet today.
alt: The lawn can wait till the weekend — it's too wet to mow.
point: ‘割草’ 说 mow the lawn，话题放回动词后

zh: 我把膝盖伤了，这个赛季打不了了。
en: I've hurt my knee, so I'm out for the rest of the season.
alt: I've done my knee in and won't play again this season.
point: 把膝盖伤了 = hurt my knee；打不了 = be out

zh: 决赛的票我抢到了，第二排！
en: I managed to get tickets to the final, second row!
alt: I snapped up tickets for the final — we're in the second row!
point: 话题‘票’放回 get 后；抢到 = manage to get

zh: 健身房的储物柜我把密码忘了，东西拿不出来。
en: I've forgotten the code for my gym locker, and I can't get my stuff out.
alt: I can't open my gym locker because I've forgotten the combination.
point: 话题‘储物柜’放进 the code for 后面

zh: 我把那本书推荐给了读书会，大家都很喜欢。
en: I recommended that book to my book club, and everyone loved it.
alt: My book club read the novel I suggested and they all loved it.
point: 把…推荐给 = recommend … to

zh: 这周末的音乐节我们买了两天的票。
en: We've got two-day passes for the music festival this weekend.
alt: We're going to both days of the music festival this weekend.
point: 话题‘音乐节’放到 passes for 后面

zh: Netflix 我退订了，反正也没时间看。
en: I've cancelled Netflix because I never have time to watch anything anyway.
alt: I got rid of my Netflix subscription — I never had time for it.
point: 话题放回 cancelled 后；‘反正’ = anyway 放句末

zh: 我跟我同事提起过你，她也喜欢徒步。
en: I've mentioned you to my colleague, she's really into tramping too.
alt: I told my workmate about you — she loves tramping as well.
point: ‘跟…提起你’ = mention you to sb，宾语在前

zh: 下周聚会的地方我还没定，你有什么建议？
en: I haven't decided where to have next week's get-together yet. Any ideas?
alt: I'm still not sure where we'll meet up next week — any suggestions?
point: 话题‘地方’ 变成 where to have …

zh: 上次你借我的伞，我一直忘了还你。
en: I keep forgetting to give you back the umbrella you lent me.
alt: I still haven't returned that umbrella you lent me — sorry!
point: 话题‘伞’放回 give back 后；你借我的 = you lent me

zh: 圣诞节的礼物我几个星期前就买齐了。
en: I finished all my Christmas shopping weeks ago.
alt: I got all my Christmas presents sorted a few weeks back.
point: ‘礼物买齐了’ 说 finish my Christmas shopping

zh: 把蜡烛点上，我去把灯关了。
en: Light the candles and I'll turn the lights off.
alt: You do the candles and I'll switch off the lights.
point: 把蜡烛点上 = light the candles，不说 point on

zh: 葬礼那天我请不了假，只能寄张卡片。
en: I can't get time off for the funeral, so I'll just send a card.
alt: I'm not able to take leave for the funeral, so I'll send a sympathy card.
point: 话题‘葬礼’ 用 time off for 引出

zh: 孩子的作业我每天晚上陪他做。
en: I sit with my son every night while he does his homework.
alt: Every evening I help my boy with his homework.
point: 话题‘作业’ 变成 while he does his homework

zh: 我们把女儿送到奶奶家了，这个周末清静了。
en: We've dropped our daughter off at her grandma's, so we'll have a quiet weekend.
alt: Our daughter's staying at her nan's, so it'll be a peaceful weekend.
point: 把…送到 = drop … off at

zh: 爸妈的签证我已经帮他们申请了，等通知就行。
en: I've applied for my parents' visas for them, so now we just wait to hear back.
alt: My parents' visa applications are in — we're just waiting for an answer.
point: 话题放回 applied for 后；等通知 = wait to hear back

zh: 我们去度假一周，狗我送去寄养了。
en: I've put the dog in kennels while we're on holiday for a week.
alt: The dog's at the kennels for the week while we're away.
point: 话题‘狗’放回动词后；寄养处 = kennels

zh: 猫的指甲你能帮我剪一下吗？它不让我碰。
en: Could you trim the cat's claws for me? She won't let me touch her.
alt: Can you clip the cat's nails? She won't let me near her.
point: 话题‘指甲’放回 trim 后；猫指甲 = claws

zh: 这只小狗是我们上个月从收容所领养的。
en: We adopted this puppy from the animal shelter last month.
alt: We got this pup from a rescue centre last month.
point: ‘是…的’ 强调句英文不需要，直接 We adopted …

zh: 我把他的玩笑当真了，现在想想挺尴尬的。
en: I took his joke seriously, and looking back it's pretty embarrassing.
alt: I didn't realise he was joking, which is a bit cringe now.
point: 把…当真 = take … seriously

zh: 这口气我实在咽不下去，他太过分了。
en: I can't just let this go, he's gone way too far.
alt: I'm not going to let this slide — he's crossed the line.
point: ‘这口气咽不下’ 不直译，说 can't let this go

zh: 我把压力都发泄在你身上了，真对不起。
en: I'm really sorry for taking my stress out on you.
alt: Sorry I've been taking things out on you.
point: 把…发泄在你身上 = take … out on you

zh: 新同事的培训我来安排，你把这周的排班表发给我就行。
en: I'll organise the training for the new starter, so just send me this week's roster when you get a chance.
alt: Leave the new starter's training to me — just flick me this week's roster.
point: 话题‘培训’放回 organise 后；排班表 = roster

zh: VPN 的问题我已经提了工单，IT 说今天下班前会有人跟进。
en: I've already logged a ticket for the VPN issue, and IT said someone will follow it up before the end of the day.
alt: I've raised a ticket about the VPN, and IT reckon someone will pick it up by close of business.
point: 话题‘VPN 的问题’ 用 a ticket for；提工单 = log a ticket

zh: 外卖我在 app 上点了，大概四十分钟到，谁要加东西赶紧跟我说。
en: I've ordered the takeaways on the app and they'll be about forty minutes, so tell me now if anyone wants to add something.
alt: Food's ordered on the app, about a forty-minute wait — shout if you want anything else added.
point: 话题‘外卖’放回 ordered 后；‘赶紧跟我说’ = tell me now

zh: 教练让我们把周四的训练改到周三，因为周四球场要维护。
en: The coach wants us to move Thursday's training to Wednesday, because they're doing maintenance on the field on Thursday.
alt: Training's shifting from Thursday to Wednesday this week, since the ground's being worked on.
point: 把 A 改到 B = move A to B；‘让我们’ = wants us to

zh: 快递员说包裹放门口了，可我回家根本没看到，你们能帮我查一下吗？
en: The courier says he left the parcel at my door, but it wasn't there when I got home. Could you look into it?
alt: Apparently my parcel was dropped at the door, but there was nothing there when I got back — can you check?
point: 话题‘包裹’放回 left 后；查一下 = look into it

zh: 租车我订的是皇后镇机场取、基督城还，可能要另付异地还车费。
en: I've booked a rental car to pick up at Queenstown Airport and drop off in Christchurch, though there might be a one-way fee.
alt: The rental's a pick-up in Queenstown and drop-off in Christchurch, so we may have to pay a one-way fee.
point: 话题‘租车’放后；取车 / 还车 = pick up / drop off

zh: 验血我帮你约在周二早上了，记得前一天晚上十点以后别吃东西。
en: I've booked your blood test for Tuesday morning, and remember not to eat anything after ten the night before.
alt: Your blood test is booked for Tuesday morning — don't eat after 10 p.m. the night before.
point: 话题‘验血’放回 booked 后；‘记得别’ = remember not to

zh: 我又把厨房水槽弄堵了，你把那个通下水道的皮搋子放哪儿了？
en: I've managed to block the kitchen sink again. Where did you put the plunger?
alt: The kitchen sink's blocked again, my fault — any idea where the plunger is?
point: 把…弄堵 = block；‘又’ 用 managed to … again 带点自嘲

zh: 你搬家那天我肯定来帮忙，车我开我哥的 ute，能装不少东西。
en: I'll definitely come and help on moving day, and I'll bring my brother's ute so we can fit heaps in.
alt: Count me in for the move — I'll borrow my brother's ute, which holds a fair bit.
point: 话题‘车’放回 bring 后；能装 = fit in

zh: 那笔钱我昨天就还你了，你查一下账户，应该已经到了。
en: I paid you back yesterday, so check your account — it should've gone through by now.
alt: I transferred the money back to you yesterday, so it ought to be in your account already.
point: 话题‘那笔钱’ 用 pay you back；到账 = go through

zh: 合同里的试用期条款我想再确认一下，是三个月还是六个月？
en: I'd just like to double-check the trial period in the contract. Is it three months or six?
alt: Could I confirm the length of the trial period in the contract — three months or six?
point: 话题放回 double-check 后；试用期 = trial period

zh: 辞职信我已经交给经理了，最后一天是下个月十五号。
en: I've handed my resignation letter to my manager, and my last day will be the fifteenth of next month.
alt: I've handed in my notice, so I'll be finishing up on the 15th of next month.
point: 话题‘辞职信’放回 handed 后；也可说 hand in my notice

zh: 那个职位我面了三轮，最后他们还是选了一个更有经验的人。
en: I went through three rounds of interviews for that role, but in the end they went with someone more experienced.
alt: After three interviews for that job, they ended up choosing someone with more experience.
point: 话题‘职位’ 用 interviews for；选了 = went with

zh: 论文初稿我交给导师了，她说下周给我反馈。
en: I've sent the first draft of my thesis to my supervisor, and she said she'll get back to me with feedback next week.
alt: My supervisor has my first draft now — she's promised feedback next week.
point: 话题‘初稿’放回 sent 后；给反馈 = get back to sb with feedback

zh: 英语课我帮你一起报了名，每周一和周三晚上上课。
en: I've enrolled us both in the English class, so it's every Monday and Wednesday evening.
alt: I signed both of us up for the English course — it runs on Monday and Wednesday nights.
point: 话题‘英语课’放到 enrol in 后；报名 = enrol in / sign up for

zh: 小组作业我那部分已经做完了，可 Tom 那部分还一个字都没写。
en: I've finished my part of the group assignment, but Tom hasn't written a single word of his yet.
alt: My section of the group project is done, whereas Tom hasn't even started his.
point: 话题放回 finished 后；一个字没写 = hasn't written a single word

zh: 下周房屋检查之前，我们得把院子收拾一下，草也得割了。
en: We need to tidy up the yard before next week's inspection, and the lawn needs mowing too.
alt: Before the inspection next week, let's sort out the yard and give the lawn a mow.
point: 话题‘院子’放回 tidy up 后；草得割 = the lawn needs mowing

zh: 租约我想再续一年，但房东说要涨房租，我们还在谈。
en: I'd like to renew the lease for another year, but the landlord wants to put the rent up, so we're still talking.
alt: I'm keen to sign on for another year, but the landlord's after a rent increase, so we're negotiating.
point: 话题‘租约’放回 renew 后；涨房租 = put the rent up

zh: 新房子的钥匙我周五去中介那儿拿，搬家的车我订了周六上午。
en: I'm picking up the keys to the new place from the agent on Friday, and I've booked the moving truck for Saturday morning.
alt: I collect the keys from the agent on Friday, and the moving van's booked for Saturday morning.
point: 两个话题都放回动词后：pick up the keys / book the truck

zh: 你家的树枝伸到我们这边来了，能不能找个时间修剪一下？
en: Your tree's started hanging over onto our side. Would you be able to trim it back sometime?
alt: Some of your branches are coming over the fence — any chance you could cut them back when you get time?
point: 话题‘树枝’ 用 hang over；修剪 = trim back

zh: 我们下周六晚上开个生日派对，噪音的事先跟你们打个招呼。
en: We're having a birthday party next Saturday night, so I just wanted to give you a heads-up about the noise.
alt: Just letting you know we've got a birthday do next Saturday night, so it might get a bit loud.
point: 话题‘噪音的事’放到 a heads-up about 后

zh: 社区的旧物交换活动我负责登记，你家有不要的东西可以拿过来。
en: I'm in charge of sign-ups for the community swap meet, so bring along anything you don't need any more.
alt: I'm running registrations for the local swap meet — feel free to drop off anything you don't want.
point: 话题‘活动’ 用 in charge of … for；拿过来 = bring along

zh: 手机套餐我想换个流量多点的，现在这个每个月都不够用。
en: I'd like to switch to a mobile plan with more data, because I keep running out every month.
alt: Could I upgrade to a plan with more data? I'm running out every single month.
point: 话题‘套餐’放回 switch to 后；不够用 = run out

zh: 燃气的账户我已经转到我名下了，以后账单直接寄给我。
en: I've transferred the gas account into my name, so the bills will come straight to me from now on.
alt: The gas account's in my name now, so all future bills will be sent to me.
point: 转到我名下 = transfer … into my name

zh: 上个月的水费我仔细看了，用量明显不对，能不能派人来查一下水表？
en: I've gone through last month's water bill and the usage looks way off. Could someone come and check the meter?
alt: Last month's water usage doesn't look right to me — would you be able to send someone to read the meter?
point: 话题‘水费’放回 gone through 后；查水表 = check the meter

zh: 热水器的事我跟房东说了，他说明天下午会派水管工过来。
en: I've told the landlord about the hot water cylinder, and he's sending a plumber round tomorrow afternoon.
alt: The landlord knows about the hot water, and he's getting a plumber in tomorrow afternoon.
point: 话题‘热水器的事’ 用 tell sb about；派人过来 = send round

zh: 这几个报价我比较了一下，最便宜的那家口碑不太好，我有点犹豫。
en: I've compared these quotes, and the cheapest one doesn't have great reviews, so I'm in two minds.
alt: Having looked at the quotes, the cheapest builder has pretty poor reviews, so I'm not sure.
point: 话题‘报价’放回 compared 后；犹豫 = in two minds

zh: 把冰箱从墙边拉出来，我看看后面是不是漏水了。
en: Can you pull the fridge out from the wall so I can see if it's leaking at the back?
alt: Help me drag the fridge away from the wall — I want to check whether it's leaking behind.
point: 把…拉出来 = pull … out from；‘我看看’ 用 so I can see

zh: 居民签证的材料我都准备齐了，就差一份无犯罪证明。
en: I've got all the documents together for my residence visa, apart from the police certificate.
alt: Everything's ready for my residence application except the police clearance.
point: 准备齐 = get … together；‘就差’ = apart from

zh: 市政府的新垃圾桶我在网上申请了，他们说两周内会送来。
en: I've applied online for a new council bin, and they said it should be delivered within two weeks.
alt: I put in an online request for a new bin, and the council reckon it'll arrive in a fortnight.
point: 话题‘垃圾桶’放回 apply for 后；送来用被动 be delivered

zh: 这些表格我不太看得懂，你能帮我把要填的地方圈出来吗？
en: I can't really make sense of these forms. Could you circle the bits I need to fill in?
alt: These forms are confusing me — would you mind marking which parts I have to complete?
point: 话题‘表格’ 用 make sense of；把…圈出来 = circle

zh: 我把车停在路边了，开着双闪，现在在等拖车。
en: I've pulled over to the side of the road with my hazards on, and I'm waiting for a tow truck.
alt: I'm parked on the roadside with the hazard lights going, waiting for a tow.
point: 把车停在路边 = pull over；双闪 = hazards

zh: 被偷的东西我列了张清单，警察说要附在报案材料里。
en: I've made a list of everything that was stolen, and the police want me to attach it to the report.
alt: I wrote down all the stolen items, and the police asked me to add the list to my report.
point: 话题‘被偷的东西’ 放到 a list of 后面

zh: 楼下的烟雾报警器我按了半天也停不下来，你能过来看看吗？
en: I've been pressing the smoke alarm downstairs for ages and I can't get it to stop. Could you come and have a look?
alt: The downstairs smoke alarm won't stop no matter what I do — can you pop over and check it?
point: 话题‘报警器’放回 pressing 后；停不下来 = can't get it to stop

zh: 车险我下个月到期，现在在比较几家的报价。
en: My car insurance is up for renewal next month, so I'm comparing quotes from a few companies.
alt: My car insurance runs out next month, so I'm shopping around for a better deal.
point: ‘车险我到期’ 主语换成 my car insurance；比价 = shop around

zh: 我把车开去做了保养，他们说轮胎也得换了。
en: I took the car in for a service, and they said the tyres need replacing as well.
alt: The car had its service today, and apparently the tyres are due to be replaced too.
point: 做保养 = take in for a service；tyres 英式拼写

zh: 去机场的路我不太熟，你把地址发给我，我开导航。
en: I don't really know the way to the airport, so send me the address and I'll use the GPS.
alt: I'm not sure how to get to the airport — text me the address and I'll follow the map.
point: 话题‘去机场的路’ = the way to；把地址发给我 = send me the address

zh: 小屋我在 DOC 网站上订好了，睡袋你们得自己带。
en: I've booked the huts on the DOC website, but you'll all need to bring your own sleeping bags.
alt: The huts are booked through DOC — just make sure everyone brings a sleeping bag.
point: 两个话题放回动词后；自己带 = bring your own

zh: 明天的天气我看了，下午有大风警告，我们最好早点出发。
en: I've checked tomorrow's forecast, and there's a strong wind warning for the afternoon, so we'd better head off early.
alt: According to the forecast there's a wind warning tomorrow afternoon, so let's get going early.
point: 话题‘天气’ 说 check the forecast；最好 = we'd better

zh: 菜园里的西红柿我都摘了，吃不完，给你送点过去。
en: I've picked all the tomatoes from the vege garden, and there are too many for us, so I'll drop some round.
alt: We've got more tomatoes from the garden than we can eat — I'll bring you some.
point: 话题‘西红柿’放回 picked 后；送过去 = drop round

zh: 下周那场演唱会的票我多出一张，你要不要一起去？
en: I've ended up with a spare ticket for that concert next week. Do you want to come along?
alt: I've got an extra ticket to next week's gig — fancy coming with me?
point: ‘多出一张票’ = have a spare ticket；一起去 = come along

zh: 吉他我学了半年就放弃了，现在想重新捡起来。
en: I gave up the guitar after six months, but now I'm thinking about picking it up again.
alt: I quit guitar after half a year, but I'm keen to get back into it.
point: 话题‘吉他’放回 gave up 后；重新捡起来 = pick it up again

zh: 理发我约在周六上午，剪完正好去参加婚礼。
en: I've booked a haircut for Saturday morning, so I'll be looking sharp for the wedding.
alt: I'm getting my hair cut on Saturday morning, just in time for the wedding.
point: 话题‘理发’ 用 book a haircut；look sharp = 精神

zh: 婚礼上的伴郎致辞我已经改了三遍了，还是觉得不够好笑。
en: I've rewritten my best man speech three times, and I still don't think it's funny enough.
alt: I'm on my third draft of the best man speech and it's still not landing the jokes.
point: 话题‘致辞’放回 rewritten 后；伴郎 = best man

zh: 春节的饺子我们打算全家一起包，你也来吧。
en: We're making dumplings together as a family for Chinese New Year, so you should come too.
alt: The whole family's getting together to make dumplings for Chinese New Year — join us!
point: 话题‘饺子’放回 make 后；包饺子 = make dumplings

zh: 同事的离职礼物大家凑了钱，我负责去买。
en: We've all chipped in for a farewell present for our colleague, and I'm the one buying it.
alt: Everyone's put money towards a leaving gift for our workmate, and I've been tasked with getting it.
point: 凑钱 = chip in for；‘我负责’ = I'm the one …

zh: 上学的事我跟他老师谈过了，她说他最近上课老走神。
en: I've had a chat with his teacher about school, and she said he's been distracted in class lately.
alt: His teacher told me he hasn't been concentrating in class recently.
point: 话题‘上学的事’ 用 have a chat about；走神 = distracted

zh: 这个周末孩子能交给你吗？我得去机场接我爸妈。
en: Can I leave the kids with you this weekend? I need to pick my parents up from the airport.
alt: Would you mind having the kids this weekend while I collect Mum and Dad from the airport?
point: 把孩子交给你 = leave the kids with you

zh: 女儿的生日派对我们包了游泳池，来二十个孩子，你能来帮忙吗？
en: We've booked the pool for our daughter's birthday party with twenty kids coming. Any chance you could give us a hand?
alt: We've hired the pool for our daughter's party and twenty kids are coming — could you help out?
point: 话题‘派对’放到 for 后；包场 = book / hire the pool

zh: 我把猫带去看了兽医，说是牙齿有问题，得洗牙。
en: I took the cat to the vet, and they said she's got dental problems and needs her teeth cleaned.
alt: The vet says the cat's teeth are bad and she'll need a dental clean.
point: 把…带去看兽医 = take … to the vet；need her teeth cleaned

zh: 养宠物的事我跟物业确认过了，猫可以养，狗不行。
en: I've checked with the property manager about pets, and cats are fine but dogs aren't allowed.
alt: According to the property manager, we can have a cat but not a dog.
point: 话题‘养宠物的事’ 用 check with … about

zh: 我们出去这两周，鱼麻烦你帮忙喂一下，一天一次就够了。
en: While we're away for the next two weeks, could you feed the fish for us? Once a day is plenty.
alt: Would you mind feeding our fish while we're away? Just once a day.
point: 话题‘鱼’放回 feed 后；一天一次就够 = once a day is plenty

zh: 那天的事我一直放在心上，想当面跟你道个歉。
en: I've been feeling bad about what happened that day, and I wanted to apologise to you in person.
alt: What happened the other day has been on my mind, and I'd like to say sorry face to face.
point: 话题‘那天的事’ = what happened；放在心上 = feel bad about

zh: 你说的那些话我不会往心里去，我知道你只是太累了。
en: I won't take what you said to heart, I know you were just really tired.
alt: Don't worry, I'm not taking it personally — I know you were exhausted.
point: 话题‘那些话’ 放进 take … to heart

zh: 工作上的烦心事我不想带回家，可总是做不到。
en: I try not to bring work stress home with me, but I never quite manage it.
alt: I'd love to leave work worries at the office, but somehow I never can.
point: 话题‘烦心事’放回 bring 后；做不到 = never manage it

zh: 关于下季度的预算，修改后的版本我已发给财务部，请您过目。
en: Regarding next quarter's budget, I have sent the revised version to Finance. Could you please take a look?
alt: With regard to the budget for next quarter, the revised version has gone to Finance for your review.
point: ‘关于…’ = Regarding …；话题‘修改后的版本’放回 sent 后

zh: 请将本周的工时表于周五下午五点前在系统中提交。
en: Please ensure that you submit this week's timesheet through the system by 5 p.m. on Friday.
alt: All timesheets for this week must be submitted via the system no later than 5 p.m. Friday.
point: ‘请将…提交’ = Please submit …；截止前 = by

zh: 这次项目延期的责任我愿意承担，补救方案我也已经拟好了。
en: I take full responsibility for the delay to this project, and I have already put together a plan to get it back on track.
alt: I accept responsibility for the project running late and have drafted a recovery plan.
point: 话题‘责任’放回 take 后；补救 = get back on track

zh: 系统迁移的时间，我们建议将其推迟到月底，以尽量减少对业务的影响。
en: With regard to the system migration, we recommend postponing it until the end of the month to minimise disruption to the business.
alt: We would advise moving the migration to the end of the month so that the business is affected as little as possible.
point: 将其推迟到 = postpone it until；minimise 英式拼写

zh: 我的账户已被锁定，烦请将密码重置，并将临时密码发至我的个人邮箱。
en: My account has been locked. Could you please reset my password and send a temporary one to my personal email address?
alt: I have been locked out of my account, so I would be grateful if you could reset the password and email a temporary one to my personal address.
point: 两个把字句：reset my password / send … to

zh: 这台笔记本还在保修期内，屏幕的问题理应免费维修。
en: This laptop is still under warranty, so I would expect the screen fault to be repaired free of charge.
alt: As the laptop is still covered by the warranty, the screen issue should be fixed at no cost to me.
point: 话题‘屏幕的问题’ 转被动：expect … to be repaired

zh: 附件是我应聘系统分析师一职的简历和求职信，敬请审阅。
en: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Systems Analyst position, for your consideration.
alt: I have attached my CV and a cover letter in application for the Systems Analyst role.
point: ‘附件是…’ 不说 The attachment is，用 Please find attached

zh: 薪资方面，我希望能在您给出的范围里偏上一些，以体现我的经验。
en: In terms of salary, I was hoping for something towards the top of your range, to reflect my experience.
alt: As for remuneration, I would be looking for the upper end of the range, given my experience.
point: ‘薪资方面’ = In terms of salary，放句首作话题

zh: 这个职位我非常感兴趣，不过通知期方面，我需要给现雇主四周时间。
en: I am very interested in this position, although I would need to give my current employer four weeks' notice.
alt: I'm keen on the role, but please note that I'm required to give four weeks' notice to my current employer.
point: 话题‘这个职位’ 用 interested in；通知期 = notice

zh: 我的论文因病未能按时提交，现申请延期一周，医生证明已附上。
en: Due to illness I was unable to submit my essay on time, so I am requesting a one-week extension and have attached a medical certificate.
alt: I was too unwell to hand in my essay by the deadline, and I would like to apply for a one-week extension. A medical certificate is attached.
point: 话题‘论文’放回 submit 后；附上 = have attached

zh: 这门课的成绩我认为可能有误，希望能申请复核。
en: I believe there may be an error in my grade for this course, and I would like to request a review.
alt: I think my mark for this paper may be incorrect, so I'd like to apply for it to be reconsidered.
point: 话题‘成绩’ 用 an error in my grade 放到后面

zh: 学费分期的事，请问能否将下一期推迟到下个月再付？
en: Regarding my fee instalments, would it be possible to defer the next payment until next month?
alt: With regard to my payment plan, could the next instalment be pushed back to next month?
point: 将…推迟到 = defer … until；instalment 英式拼写

zh: 厨房漏水造成的地板损坏，我已拍照存档，并附在了保险理赔申请里。
en: I have photographed the floor damage caused by the kitchen leak and included the photos with my insurance claim.
alt: Photos of the damage the kitchen leak did to the floor are included with my claim.
point: 话题‘地板损坏’放回 photographed 后

zh: 上周预订的地毯清洗，贵公司的人员根本没有上门，请将费用退还给我。
en: Your cleaners did not arrive for the carpet cleaning I booked last week, so I would like the fee refunded.
alt: Nobody from your company turned up for my carpet clean last week, and I am asking for a full refund.
point: ‘将费用退还’ = have the fee refunded / refund the fee

zh: 花园维护这一块，我们希望把合同从每周一次改为两周一次。
en: As for the garden maintenance, we would like to change the contract from weekly to fortnightly visits.
alt: With regard to the gardening service, we'd like to reduce it from once a week to once a fortnight.
point: 把 A 改为 B = change from A to B；两周一次 = fortnightly

zh: 押金退还的问题，我已多次联系您，但至今仍未收到答复。
en: I have contacted you several times regarding the return of my bond, but I have yet to receive a reply.
alt: Despite several attempts to contact you about my bond refund, I still have not heard back.
point: 话题‘押金’ 用 regarding 放到后面；至今仍未 = have yet to

zh: 卧室的霉菌问题我三月份就书面报告过了，但至今仍未处理。
en: I reported the mould in the bedroom in writing in March, but it still has not been dealt with.
alt: The bedroom mould was reported in writing back in March and has still not been addressed.
point: 话题‘霉菌’放回 reported 后；未处理 = has not been dealt with

zh: 请将本次检查报告的副本发给我，以便我核实里面列出的问题。
en: Please send me a copy of the inspection report so that I can check the issues it lists.
alt: Could you forward me a copy of the inspection report so I can go through the items noted?
point: ‘请将…发给我’ = Please send me …，不需要‘将’

zh: 关于共用车道停车的问题，我希望我们能达成一个双方都满意的安排。
en: With regard to parking on our shared driveway, I hope we can come to an arrangement that suits us both.
alt: On the matter of the shared driveway, I'm hoping we can agree on something that works for both households.
point: ‘关于’ = With regard to；达成安排 = come to an arrangement

zh: 更换边界篱笆的费用，我建议双方各承担一半，报价单已附上供您参考。
en: I suggest we share the cost of replacing the boundary fence equally, and I have attached the quote for your reference.
alt: I propose we split the cost of the new boundary fence fifty-fifty; the quote is attached.
point: 话题‘费用’放回 share 后；供参考 = for your reference

zh: 深夜噪音的问题，我们已经当面提过好几次，现在不得不以书面形式提出。
en: We have raised the late-night noise with you several times in person, and we now feel we must put it in writing.
alt: Having mentioned the noise late at night to you more than once, we are now raising it formally in writing.
point: 话题‘噪音’放回 raise … with you；以书面形式 = put it in writing

zh: 上个季度的电费我认为算错了，请把详细的用电记录发给我。
en: I believe last quarter's power bill has been calculated incorrectly. Please send me a detailed breakdown of my usage.
alt: There seems to be a mistake in my power bill for last quarter, so I'd appreciate a full breakdown of my usage.
point: 话题‘电费’ 转被动 has been calculated；明细 = breakdown

zh: 宽带整整中断了五天，这段时间的费用我希望能够减免。
en: Since my broadband was down for five full days, I would like the charges for that period to be waived.
alt: As I had no internet for five days, I am requesting a credit for that period.
point: 话题‘费用’ 用 would like … to be waived

zh: 我月底搬走，请将账户在三十号关闭，并把最终账单寄到我的新地址。
en: I am moving out at the end of the month, so please close the account on the 30th and send the final bill to my new address.
alt: As I'm moving at the end of the month, could you close my account on the 30th and forward the final bill to my new address?
point: 两个把字句：close the account / send the bill to

zh: 浴室翻新的工程，我们希望把完工日期写进合同。
en: Regarding the bathroom renovation, we would like the completion date to be written into the contract.
alt: For the bathroom renovation, we'd like a firm completion date included in the contract.
point: 把…写进合同 = have … written into the contract

zh: 这次的维修质量我非常不满意，屋顶修好不到一周又开始漏水了。
en: I am very unhappy with the quality of the repair, as the roof started leaking again within a week of being fixed.
alt: The repair was not up to standard: the roof was leaking again less than a week later.
point: 话题‘维修质量’ 用 unhappy with 引出

zh: 请把书面报价连同材料明细一起发给我，方便我比较。
en: Please send me a written quote, including a breakdown of materials, so that I can compare it with others.
alt: Could you email me a written quote along with an itemised list of materials so I can compare prices?
point: ‘连同…一起’ = including / along with

zh: 这台吸尘器我买了不到一个月就坏了，我要求全额退款，而不是维修。
en: The vacuum cleaner I bought less than a month ago has stopped working, and I would like a full refund rather than a repair.
alt: I bought this vacuum less than a month ago and it has already broken down, so I'm asking for my money back, not a repair.
point: 话题‘吸尘器’ 变成 The vacuum cleaner I bought 作主语

zh: 订单号 4417 的货到现在还没到，请尽快帮我查一下物流情况。
en: My order (number 4417) has still not arrived, so I would appreciate it if you could check its delivery status urgently.
alt: Order 4417 still hasn't been delivered — could you please track it down as a matter of urgency?
point: 话题‘货’ 换成 my order 作主语；查物流 = check delivery status

zh: 我被重复扣了款，请将多收的金额退回到我的信用卡上。
en: I have been charged twice for the same order, so please refund the extra amount to my credit card.
alt: My card was charged twice for one order, and I'd like the duplicate payment refunded.
point: 将…退回到 = refund … to；重复扣款 = charged twice

zh: 周六晚上二十人的包间我们已经订好了，菜单方面希望能提前确认。
en: We have booked the private room for twenty people on Saturday evening and would like to confirm the menu in advance.
alt: Following our booking of the private room for twenty this Saturday, we'd like to finalise the menu beforehand.
point: 话题‘包间’放回 booked 后；‘菜单方面’放回 confirm 后

zh: 昨晚的用餐我不得不投诉，主菜我们等了一个多小时。
en: I am writing to complain about our dinner last night, as we waited more than an hour for our main courses.
alt: I wish to make a complaint about last night's meal: our mains took over an hour to arrive.
point: 话题‘用餐’ 用 complain about 引出

zh: 我的过敏情况订位时已经注明了，可上来的菜里还是有花生。
en: I mentioned my allergy when I made the booking, yet one of the dishes still contained peanuts.
alt: Although I noted my peanut allergy when booking, peanuts were still in one of the dishes served.
point: 话题‘过敏情况’放回 mentioned 后；注明 = mention / note

zh: 这笔可疑的交易我从来没有授权过，请立即冻结这张卡并展开调查。
en: I did not authorise this suspicious transaction, so please block the card immediately and investigate.
alt: This transaction was not authorised by me. Please freeze the card straight away and look into it.
point: 话题‘交易’放回 authorise 后；冻结卡 = block the card

zh: 房贷续期的事，我希望能把固定利率期延长到三年。
en: Regarding my mortgage renewal, I would like to extend the fixed-rate term to three years.
alt: When my mortgage comes up for renewal, I'd like to fix it for three years.
point: 把…延长到 = extend … to；‘…的事’ = Regarding

zh: 这笔贷款我希望能提前还清，请告知是否需要支付提前还款费。
en: I would like to repay this loan early, so could you please let me know whether there is an early repayment fee?
alt: I'm hoping to pay off the loan ahead of schedule — would any early repayment charges apply?
point: 话题‘这笔贷款’放回 repay 后；提前还清 = repay early

zh: 我的护照续签申请上个月就交了，至今没有任何消息，请问现在进展如何？
en: I submitted my passport renewal application last month and have not heard anything since. Could you tell me how it is progressing?
alt: It has been a month since I applied to renew my passport, and I would appreciate an update on its progress.
point: 话题‘申请’放回 submitted 后；进展 = how it is progressing

zh: 所需的证明文件我已经全部上传，如有遗漏，请告知。
en: I have uploaded all the required supporting documents, but please let me know if anything is missing.
alt: All the supporting documents you asked for are now uploaded; please tell me if I've left anything out.
point: 话题‘证明文件’放回 uploaded 后；遗漏 = missing

zh: 这张停车罚单我想提出申诉，当时我的车停在合法车位上。
en: I would like to dispute this parking fine, as my car was parked in a legal space at the time.
alt: I wish to challenge this parking infringement because I was parked legally at the time.
point: 话题‘罚单’放回 dispute 后；申诉 = dispute

zh: 我已经搬到奥克兰了，请把我的病历转给新的家庭医生。
en: I have moved to Auckland, so could you please transfer my medical records to my new GP?
alt: As I've relocated to Auckland, I'd be grateful if my medical records could be sent to my new GP.
point: 把病历转给 = transfer my records to

zh: 这几次理疗的费用我是自己先付的，请问 ACC 能否给我报销？
en: I have paid for these physio sessions myself, so could you tell me whether ACC will be able to reimburse me?
alt: I covered the cost of my physio myself — is it possible for ACC to pay me back?
point: 话题‘费用’ 用 pay for；‘自己先付’ = pay myself

zh: 这台手术，我的保险公司要求先提供专科医生的报告才能批准。
en: My insurer has asked for a specialist's report before they will approve this operation.
alt: Before approving the surgery, my insurance company needs a report from the specialist.
point: 话题‘这台手术’放回 approve 后

zh: 这次事故造成的车辆损坏我已经拍照，也报了警，现在想提出理赔。
en: I have photographed the damage to my car and reported the accident to the police, and I would now like to make a claim.
alt: The damage to my vehicle has been photographed and the accident reported to police; I now wish to lodge a claim.
point: 两个话题放回动词后：photographed the damage / reported the accident

zh: 被盗物品的清单和警方的报案编号我都附在这封邮件里了。
en: I have included a list of the stolen items and the police report number in this email.
alt: Please find below a list of the stolen items together with the police reference number.
point: 话题‘清单和编号’放回 included 后

zh: 暴雨造成的屋顶损坏，请尽快派评估员上门查看。
en: Regarding the roof damage caused by the storm, could you please send an assessor out as soon as possible?
alt: Could an assessor please be sent to inspect the storm damage to our roof as soon as possible?
point: 话题‘屋顶损坏’ 用 Regarding；派人上门 = send … out

zh: 这次的修车费用应该由对方的保险公司承担，因为事故完全是对方的责任。
en: The cost of repairing my car should be covered by the other driver's insurer, as the accident was entirely their fault.
alt: Since the other driver was wholly at fault, their insurance company should pay for my repairs.
point: 话题‘修车费用’ 转被动 covered by

zh: 车我已经卖了，但过户手续还没办完，请问我还需要做什么？
en: I have sold my car, but the change of ownership has not been completed yet. What else do I need to do?
alt: Although I've sold the vehicle, the ownership transfer is still incomplete, so could you advise me on the next steps?
point: 话题‘过户手续’ 转被动 has not been completed

zh: 这份车辆检查报告请转给保险公司，作为理赔的依据。
en: Could you please forward this vehicle inspection report to the insurer as supporting evidence for my claim?
alt: Please pass the inspection report on to the insurance company to support my claim.
point: 把…转给 = forward … to；依据 = supporting evidence

zh: 我的托运行李在转机时丢了，找到后请直接送到我住的酒店。
en: My checked bag went missing during my transfer, so please deliver it to my hotel as soon as it is found.
alt: My suitcase was lost during the connection, and I would like it delivered to my hotel once located.
point: 话题‘行李’ 作主语；送到 = deliver it to

zh: 取消航班的费用，按你们的政策应该全额退还，但我只收到了一部分。
en: Under your policy, the cost of my cancelled flight should be refunded in full, but I have only received part of it.
alt: According to your terms, I'm entitled to a full refund for the cancelled flight, yet only part has been paid.
point: 话题‘费用’ 转被动 refunded in full

zh: 旅行期间的医疗费用，收据和诊断书我已经一并交给了保险公司。
en: I have submitted the receipts and the doctor's report to my travel insurer for the medical costs I incurred overseas.
alt: For the medical expenses from my trip, I've sent both the receipts and the doctor's report to my insurer.
point: 话题‘医疗费用’ 用 for 放到句末；产生费用 = incur

zh: 下个月的团队徒步，请各位在周五前把紧急联系人信息发给我。
en: Ahead of next month's team tramp, could everyone please send me their emergency contact details by Friday?
alt: For next month's group tramp, I'll need everyone's emergency contact details by Friday.
point: 话题‘徒步’ 用 Ahead of；把…发给我 = send me …

zh: 营地的预订，我需要把日期从十二号改到十四号，差价我可以补上。
en: I need to change my campsite booking from the 12th to the 14th, and I am happy to pay any difference.
alt: Could I move my campsite booking from the 12th to the 14th? I'll cover any extra cost.
point: 把日期从…改到 = change from … to；补差价 = pay the difference

zh: 公园里那棵倒下的树，我上周已经向市政报告了，但现在还挡着步道。
en: I reported the fallen tree in the park to the council last week, but it is still blocking the walkway.
alt: The fallen tree in the park, which I reported to the council last week, is still across the path.
point: 话题‘那棵树’放回 reported 后

zh: 这期的会员费我已经交了，但系统仍然显示我的账户被暂停。
en: I have already paid this term's membership fee, but my account still shows as suspended.
alt: Even though my membership fee for this term has been paid, the system has my account listed as suspended.
point: 话题‘会员费’放回 paid 后；显示为 = show as

zh: 下赛季的场地租用，我们希望把训练时间固定在每周二晚上。
en: Regarding the field hire for next season, we would like to lock in Tuesday evenings for our training.
alt: For next season's ground booking, we'd like Tuesday nights reserved for training on a regular basis.
point: 话题用 Regarding；把时间固定 = lock in

zh: 我的健身房会员请从下个月起暂停三个月，我要出国工作。
en: Please put my gym membership on hold for three months from next month, as I will be working overseas.
alt: I'd like to freeze my membership for three months starting next month while I'm working abroad.
point: 把会员暂停 = put … on hold / freeze

zh: 读书会的场地，我们希望能把每月的预订延续到明年。
en: We would like to extend our monthly booking of the community room for our book club into next year.
alt: Our book club would like to keep its regular monthly booking of the room going into next year.
point: 话题‘场地’ 放进 extend our booking of

zh: 演出取消后的退款我到现在都没收到，已经过去六个星期了。
en: It has been six weeks since the show was cancelled, and I still have not received my refund.
alt: Six weeks after the show's cancellation, my refund has still not come through.
point: 话题‘退款’放回 received 后；已经过去 = It has been

zh: 这门陶艺课我报的本来是周末班，却被安排到了工作日晚上。
en: I originally enrolled in the weekend pottery class, but I have been placed in the weekday evening group instead.
alt: Although I signed up for the weekend pottery class, I've been put in a weeknight group.
point: 话题‘陶艺课’ 用 enrol in；被安排 = be placed

zh: 这次聚会的场地费由我们公司承担，各位只需自带饮料。
en: The venue hire for this get-together will be covered by our company, so guests need only bring their own drinks.
alt: Our company is paying for the venue, so all you need to bring is your own drinks.
point: 话题‘场地费’ 转被动 covered by；只需 = need only

zh: 感谢您上周的热情款待，您推荐的那本书我已经开始读了。
en: Thank you for your kind hospitality last week. I have already started reading the book you recommended.
alt: Many thanks for having us last week — I've begun the book you suggested.
point: 话题‘那本书’放回 reading 后；推荐的书 = the book you recommended

zh: 俱乐部的年度晚宴，我们诚挚邀请您作为嘉宾出席并致辞。
en: We would be delighted if you could attend our club's annual dinner as a guest speaker.
alt: We would like to formally invite you to speak as our guest at the club's annual dinner.
point: 话题‘年度晚宴’放回 attend 后；诚挚邀请 = would be delighted if

zh: 婚礼场地的定金我们已经付了，尾款会在婚礼前一个月付清。
en: We have paid the deposit for the wedding venue, and the balance will be paid in full one month before the wedding.
alt: The venue deposit is paid, and we'll settle the remaining balance a month before the big day.
point: 话题‘定金’放回 paid 后；尾款 = the balance

zh: 家里有亲人去世，这周的工作我想交给同事处理，并请几天丧假。
en: Due to a death in the family, I would like to hand this week's work over to a colleague and take a few days' bereavement leave.
alt: Following a family bereavement, I'm requesting a few days' leave and would like a colleague to cover my work this week.
point: 把…交给同事 = hand … over to；丧假 = bereavement leave

zh: 圣诞期间的营业时间我们已在官网更新，请各位顾客留意。
en: We have updated our opening hours for the Christmas period on our website, and we ask customers to take note.
alt: Our Christmas opening hours are now on our website, so please check them before visiting.
point: 话题‘营业时间’放回 updated 后；留意 = take note

zh: 我儿子下周因家事缺课三天，作业麻烦老师通过邮件发给我。
en: My son will be absent for three days next week due to a family matter, so could his teacher please email me his work?
alt: Owing to a family commitment my son will miss three days of school next week; I'd appreciate it if his work could be emailed to me.
point: 话题‘作业’放回 email me 后

zh: 关于孩子的校服补助，请问申请表应该交到哪个部门？
en: With regard to the school uniform grant, could you tell me which office I should submit the application form to?
alt: Regarding the uniform grant, who should I send the application form to?
point: 交到哪个部门 = submit … to which office，介词放句末

zh: 女儿在托儿所的时间，我们希望从下学期起改为每周五天。
en: We would like to increase our daughter's daycare hours to five days a week from next term.
alt: From next term, we'd like our daughter to attend daycare five days a week.
point: 话题‘托儿所的时间’ 用 increase … to

zh: 狗的注册费我在截止日期前就交了，却还是收到了逾期通知。
en: I paid my dog's registration fee before the due date, yet I have still received an overdue notice.
alt: Despite paying the dog registration fee on time, I've been sent a late payment notice.
point: 话题‘注册费’放回 paid 后；逾期通知 = overdue notice

zh: 关于在房子里养猫一事，我愿意额外支付宠物押金，并承担一切损坏的费用。
